articles.summary: GREENWICH, Conn. , Oct. 29, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oxford Square Capital Corp. (NasdaqGS: OXSQ ) (NasdaqGS: OXSQG) (NasdaqGS: OXSQH) announced today that it will hold a conference call to discuss third quarter 2025 earnings on Tuesday, November 4, 2025 at 9:00 AM Eastern time .
articles.title: Oxford Square Capital Corp. Schedules Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call for November 4, 2025
